 Blackhawks at Red Wings projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 29, 2026 
 Link copied 
 BLACKHAWKS (4-8-0) at RED WINGS (5-4-3) 
 7:30 p.m. ET; Disney+, HULU, ESPN+, SN+ 
 Blackhawks projected lineup 
 Roman Kantserov -- Connor Bedard -- Teuvo Teravainen
 Tyler Bertuzzi -- Anton Frondell -- Ryan Donato
 Oliver Moore -- Frank Nazar -- Patrick Kane
 Cole Smith -- Jordan Greenway -- Ryan Greene
 Alex Vlasic -- Ian Cole
 Wyatt Kaiser -- Artyom Levshunov
 Kevin Korchinski -- Sam Rinzel
 Spencer Knight
 Arvid Soderblom
 Scratched: Andrew Mangiapane, Ethan Del Mastro 
 Injured: Bowen Byram (upper body) 
 Red Wings projected lineup 
 Alex DeBrincat -- Emmitt Finnie -- Viktor Arvidsson
 Michael Brandsegg-Nygard -- Andrew Copp -- Lucas Raymond
 Michael Rasmussen -- Nate Danielson -- J.T. Compher
 Carter Mazur -- Keegan Kolesar
 Ben Chiarot -- Moritz Seider
 William Wallinder -- Justin Faulk
 Andreas Englund -- Anton Johansson
 Axel Sandin-Pellikka
 John Gibson
 Daniil Tarasov
 Scratched: Axel Sandin-Pellikka, Sheldon Dries 
 Injured: Mason Appleton (undisclosed), Marco Kasper (upper body), Albert Johansson (undisclosed) 
 Suspended: Dylan Larkin 
 Status report 
 Vlasic will be a game-time decision after missing the Blackhawks morning skate because of an illness. ... Greene and Teravainen will switch lines. ... Larkin will not play. He was suspended by the team without pay after telling the team he would not play until he is traded. … Kane will face Detroit for the first time since playing with the Red Wings the past three seasons. ... Tarasov will return after missing three games with an undisclosed injury and will back up Gibson. ... Dries, a forward was recalled from Grand Rapids of the American Hockey League and goalie Michal Postava was reassigned there.
